sources.section: §4 Presets, UzEngine preset (the preset table); §5 Determinism and verification
sources.facts: The seven outputs <set>_albedo (basecolor RGB + opacity A, PNG8, BC7 sRGB, binding albedo), <set>_normal (virtual normal in the Phase 0 convention, PNG8/16, BC5, linear, negative-Z texels fail or route to RGB), <set>_orm (AO_Mixed, roughness, metallic; PNG8, BC7 linear, binding orm), <set>_emissive (PNG8, BC7 sRGB), <set>_height (PNG16 + explicit format metadata, BC4 linear), <set>_specularweight (PNG8/16, BC4, no engine slot: a consumer gap) and <set>.uzmat (TextureSample -> PBROutput pins 0..6 with the inline scene-material block); canonical 16-bit/float maps beside every cooked derivative (EXP-10); the receipt's per-file fields.

sources.page: UzPainter decision 023 (owner answer Q10); decision 021 (owner answer Q8)
sources.section: UzEngine .uzmat with compressed .uztexture; SpecularWeight as a consumer gap; formats written by UzPainter's own code
sources.facts: UzEngine is delivered as .uzmat plus compressed .uztexture (BC7/BC5/BC4), both written by UzPainter's own code from the format definition with no UzEngine library linked or called; SpecularWeight is exported and reported as a consumer gap.
The .uztexture layout and its formats BC4, BC5 and BC7 with the sRGB flag (decision 315: the declarations win over the header's comments; BC4 and BC5 are always linear).
PBROutput pins BaseColor, Metallic, Roughness, Normal, Emissive, Opacity and AO, fed by texture samples; no height pin (src/export/EXPORT.md §5, UzEngine material writer).
The inline block sets albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, ao, emissive and orm paths and the multipliers; no inline key assigns an opacity or a height map.

sources.section: the fixed-PBR path: ORM, normal decode, albedo alpha
sources.facts: ORM is sampled as R = AO, G = roughness, B = metallic; the normal's XY is decoded from RG and Z reconstructed (non-negative); the bindless fixed-PBR path reads albedo .a, the SM5 path never reads it as opacity (docs/analysis/uzengine-renderer/10-review-response.md §7).

A cooked .uztexture companion beside a texture is probed first, and its GPU format comes from the file's own header (docs/analysis/uzengine-renderer/04-material-and-texture-standard.md §2.1): the BC4 height companion carries the explicit format the cooker's file-name rule would otherwise set to BC7 sRGB.

UzEngine (commit f4dcfc46, a descendant of a703c95 with no change to gbuffer_ps.hlsl, uzmesh, mesh tangents, scene_loader or the material files) reads green as -v, the DirectX convention, for meshes uzmesh cooks from OBJ.

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap basecolor, A from documentMap opacity (dropped when the stack has no opacity channel, probe P7), PNG 8; its .uztexture is BC7 sRGB with alpha-coverage-preserving mips (binding albedo), cooked from canonical/$textureSet_albedo
packing.source: 08-export.md §4 (albedo row): opacity in alpha for the bindless fixed-PBR path; the SM5 route is reported unsupported for opacity in the receipt

packing.decision: The albedo's channels at PNG 16: the canonical 16-bit companion of the PNG 8 file and its derivative
packing.source: 08-export.md §4 (canonical maps beside the cooked derivatives, EXP-10)

packing.decision: RGB from virtualMap Normal_DirectX (combined: mesh normal, Normal channel and height-derived normal), PNG 16, its own canonical companion; its .uztexture is BC5 linear (binding normal), negative-Z policy fail
packing.source: 08-export.md §4 (normal row; PNG8/16 resolved to 16 so the file is its canonical map, decision 316); the Phase 0 verdict for UzEngine: green -v (parity/reports/phase0/normal-convention.md §8)

packing.decision: R from virtualMap AO_Mixed, G from documentMap roughness, B from documentMap metallic, PNG 8; its .uztexture is BC7 linear (binding orm), cooked from canonical/$textureSet_orm; refused until AO_Mixed is fitted (decision 131)
The ORM's channels at PNG 16: the canonical companion
RGB from documentMap emissive, PNG 8; its .uztexture is BC7 sRGB with colour mips (binding emissive), cooked from canonical/$textureSet_emissive
The emissive's channels at PNG 16: the canonical companion

L from documentMap height, PNG 16 (written as v * 0.5 + 0.5), its own canonical companion; its .uztexture is BC4 linear (binding heightmap), the explicit-format companion the cooker would otherwise make BC7 sRGB; no .uzmat pin or inline key binds it: a consumer gap

L from documentMap specularweight, PNG 16 (PNG8/16 resolved to 16, its own canonical companion), written when the stack has the channel; its .uztexture is BC4 linear with no engine binding; the receipt reports it as a consumer gap

$textureSet.uzmat at the delivery root: pins 0..6 bound to the albedo, ORM, normal and emissive derivatives of the same generation (src/export/uzmat_writer.h), blend Masked when the albedo derivative holds an alpha, Opaque otherwise; the inline scene-material block in the receipt; skipped, and listed, when one of its four textures is not written

Files named $textureSet_<output>; every map sets fileFormat png and its bitDepth, while padding and dithering come from exportParameters; each derivative's engine format, colour space, mip class and binding are stated in the preset's uzengine block, never inferred from a file name

pending.what: AO_Mixed, the ORM's R, is fitted exactly (recordings R-086a and R-092, else R-131 of decision 131); until then every plan of this preset that writes $textureSet_orm is refused before anything is written.
